card.name: Digit after 2 or 19 in years
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a four-digit year, mainly the 0 in 2010s years (2011, 2012, 2013) and the 7 in 1970s years. It appears in citations, retrieval dates and page dates.

modes.label: The 0 in 201x
modes.description: The zero after 2 when a year in the early 2010s is written in a date or citation.

modes.label: The 7 in 197x
modes.description: The seven after 19 in a year from the 1970s.

card.plain: It marks the middle digit of a year like 2012 or 1971, usually in a reference or date.
